For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: April 8th, 2022 - November 20th, 2023, April 24, 2024, May 20th 2024
  • Number of Frames: 44,341 frames
  • Resolution: 12 centimetre
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit
  • Number of bands: Four band (RGBN)
  • Format: TIFF (ISAT AT model setup)
  • Camera(s): Vexcel UltraCam Eagle frame-based
NOTE: There are two flight lines that were reflown over the GTA area in spring of 2024, this was due to haze and low visibility in images from the original flight. View the acquisition area for each layer by clicking the links near the bottom of this record.  A new page opens, and you may need to zoom in to see the individual one-kilometre squared tiles. To download the index, click the ‘View Full Details’ button and finally the ‘Download’ button near the top of the page that opens. Alternatively, you can click HERE to bring the map up in an ArcGIS online map viewer.
 

 

For more information on the South Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (SCOOP) 2023 please see the main SCOOP 2023 GeoHub record.

 
Available Products:
Stereo Frames
  • South Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (SCOOP) 2023 - Stereo Frames and associated AT Models
  • South Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (SCOOP) 2023 - GTA Reflight Lines - Stereo Frames and associated AT Models
